theorem_scope: width<=3 CNF instances for which a global polarity renaming exists that makes every clause Horn
algorithm: remove tautological clauses and duplicate literals exactly
construct a 2CNF instance over one flip-bit per source variable; each pair of literals in a source clause forbids both renamed literals from being positive
apply the certified polarity flip to the source
verify every renamed clause is Horn and that inverse renaming reconstructs the cleaned source
solve the renamed Horn formula with the native Horn solver
map a SAT witness back through the polarity flip; preserve UNSAT exactly
complexity_contract: For width<=3, flip-recognition has O(number_of_literal_occurrences) pair constraints, followed by 2SAT plus Horn solving; no boundary-state enumeration.
external_context_non_authoritative: q-Horn is a larger known tractable language reserved for a later APMA morph
next_if_fail: preserve exact falsifier and repair only the claimed recognition/renaming theorem
